docs.purpose: Lets an admin simulate what a contractor in a given trade would see in their lead feed at a chosen location, so staff can test and QA the lead-matching and ranking algorithm before it reaches real users.
docs.data_story: It reads 12 tables — `wsib_registry`, `permits`, `permit_trades`, `trades`, `cost_estimates`, `neighbourhoods`, `lead_views`, `entities`, `entity_projects`, `coa_applications`, `trade_forecasts` and `pg_extension` and writes nothing. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `admin_lead_feed`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

state.why: A CONTRACT holds no client state: every value is resolved per request on the server and nothing is cached in a client store by the route itself.

rls_class.why: It reaches user-owned rows whose policies key on auth.uid(), alongside default-deny Class B pipeline tables. The route connects as the table owner (raw pg), which Spec 114 §9 makes owner-exempt from RLS — the class describes the data, not the gate this route passes.

notes: Delegates the feed query to getLeadFeed() in src/features/leads/lib/get-lead-feed.ts — the same engine /api/leads/feed uses — but with the CoA UNION arm explicitly enabled (disableCoa:false), unlike the production default. pg_extension is the Postgres catalog, read by isPostgisAvailable() in src/lib/admin/test-feed-utils.ts, not an application table. Response passes result.data through plus a computed _debug block, so no named projection whitelist. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: Census checklist: all 12 named tables/catalogs VERIFIED (incl. pg_extension). Census MISSED `profiles` (read by verifyAdminAuth, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:117-120). FINDINGS: (1) DEAD PAGINATION — getLeadFeed returns meta.next_cursor (src/features/leads/lib/get-lead-feed.ts:1059-1069) and the route forwards meta verbatim (:125), but testFeedSchema (:31-40) declares NO cursor field and the route never passes input.cursor, so page 2 is unreachable through this endpoint. (2) The route hard-codes `disableCoa: false` (:104), overriding the getLeadFeed default of true (src/features/leads/lib/get-lead-feed.ts:1013) — the admin feed is always 3-arm. (3) Error-message disclosure is environment-gated: non-production returns the real pg error, sanitized only for connection-string credentials (:138-140, src/lib/admin/test-feed-utils.ts:36). (4) `builders_in_results` counts lead_type==='builder' (src/lib/admin/test-feed-utils.ts:96) while the route's lead_type filter only offers all|permit|coa (:39) — builders surface only under 'all' (src/features/leads/lib/get-lead-feed.ts:493). (5) The comment at :100-103 asserts the CoA killswitch is 'a mobile-renderability gate, not a data gate' — a claim, not evidence. (6) No SELECT * against a base table; the `SELECT *` at get-lead-feed.ts:499-512 reads CTEs with explicit column lists. (7) LEAD_FEED_SQL_WITH_COA is built by regex string-replace at module load (:700-704) with a fail-fast boot throw at :709-716. | Caching: No response caching (no Cache-Control, no dynamic/revalidate). There IS a process-lifetime in-memory cache of the PostGIS pre-flight result: `postgisChecked` at src/lib/admin/test-feed-utils.ts:55, short-circuit at :63, populated at :68; failures are deliberately NOT cached (:70-72). | Pagination: limit clamped by Zod to [1,30] at src/app/api/admin/leads/test-feed/route.ts:36 and re-clamped at src/features/leads/lib/get-lead-feed.ts:1004; the SQL pages by cursor tuple (relevance_score, lead_type, lead_id) at src/features/leads/lib/get-lead-feed.ts:535-540 with LIMIT $5 at :540. | Other guards / classification: CSRF Origin check does not apply (GET is not in MUTATING_METHODS, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:45,70).
